correctness.rationale: PASS. The planar polygon mixed-area formula reduces the cross coefficient to a sum of one polygon support function at edge normals of the other. With m=gM,n=gN and L=lcm(m,n), coprimality of M,N makes the selected angular residues one length-M consecutive grid with spacing 2pi/L, repeated g times. The finite cosine sum is g sin(pi/n)cos(d(phi))/sin(pi/L), giving A0+Bcos d globally, including tie angles. Coincident edge normals occur exactly at minimizing orientations and in exactly gcd(m,n) directions, proving the side count m+n-g versus m+n. The cusp expansion, cosine-distribution under uniform rotation, mean perimeter product/(2pi), and L^-2 range follow by one-variable analysis. Independent fresh support-functional evaluations on 2,025 random (m,n,r,s,phi) instances matched the formula; finite tests are not the proof.
residual_risks: The asymptotic requires m,n both tending to infinity at fixed positive radii.
